hook_quantization_pertensor: hook quantization per-tensor to apply MinMaxObserver-based quantization to DDP gradient buckets using allgather protocol
hook_quantization_perchannel: hook quantization per-channel to apply PerChannelMinMaxObserver-based quantization to large DDP gradient buckets split by bucket_size
quantize_per_tensor_cuda: quantize a CUDA tensor per-tensor using scale and zero_point with MinMaxObserver range to uint8 values clamped 0-255
dequantize_per_tensor_cuda: dequantize a uint8 quantized CUDA tensor back to float32 using scale and zero_point
quantize_per_channel_cuda: quantize a CUDA tensor per-channel by iterating over rows with per-row scale and zero_point to uint8 values clamped 0-255
